title: Testable questions sorting cards
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Working scientifically, revision through enquiry (Revolution)
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 27 (Testable questions sorting cards (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 27: Asking scientific questions. To understand what makes a question one that science can answer by testing

cards: Does salt dissolve faster in warm water?
Which paper towel soaks up most water?
Does a longer ruler make a lower note?
blocks.title: Sort into: Testable / Not testable
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Testable, Not testable.
blocks.answer: Testable: Does salt dissolve faster in warm water?; Which paper towel soaks up most water?; Does a longer ruler make a lower note?. Not testable: Is red the best colour?; Do cats like music?; Is science fun?

questions.q: Make this testable: 'Which shoes are best?'
questions.a: For example: 'Which shoe sole has the most grip on a slope?'
questions.model: Find the vague word: 'best'. Choose something measurable: grip, measured by the angle a shoe starts to slide. Rewrite: 'Which shoe sole grips most on a slope?'

questions.a: We can change something and measure the result

questions.q: Is 'Do plants like rain?' testable as it is?
Write three testable questions about things in your home. For each, say what you would change and what you would measure.
questions.a: Three questions, each with a change and a measure, e.g. 'Does more water make cress grow taller?' change: water, measure: height
questions.model: Teacher writes the first: 'Does the height I drop a ball from change its bounce? Change: drop height. Measure: bounce height.'

questions.q: Turn two vague questions from the sort into testable ones.
questions.a: e.g. 'Is red the best colour?' becomes 'Which colour T-shirt gets hottest in the sun?'

questions.q: Why can science not answer every question?
questions.a: Some questions are about opinions or things we cannot measure

questions.q: A testable question needs something we can...
Big question: how would you make 'Which is the best ball?' testable?
questions.a: Say what is measured: 'Which ball bounces highest when dropped from 1 m?'
